extraction.document_summary: AIA Mum2Baby Choices is a prenatal protection proposition with guaranteed lifelong protection for the child, starting from as early as the 13th week of pregnancy. It is offered via two bundled base options: AIA Mum2Baby Protect (a participating whole life plan with boosted protection and stable cash value) and AIA Mum2Baby (an investment-linked plan that bolsters protection during early years and supports investment growth later). Both bundles cover the mother and baby for defined events, including pregnancy complications, childbirth-related medical negligence, congenital illnesses, and hospitalisation benefits. A key mechanic is that the prenatal base plan and applicable riders can be transferred to the child within 100 days from birth “with no medical questions asked,” and coverage is stated as guaranteed up to age 100.
quality_notes: Document provides clear benefit names, payout amounts tied to coverage amount, and stated timeframes (13th week, 100 days transfer, age 100).
Initial underwriting requirements for purchase of the base policy/riders are not explicitly stated; only the transfer is described as without medical questions.
No specific exclusion list is provided; only a generic statement that some conditions result in no benefits payable.

policies.quick_summary: AIA Mum2Baby Protect is a participating whole life prenatal bundle under AIA Mum2Baby Choices. It provides protection for the expectant mother and baby from as early as the 13th week of pregnancy and includes benefits for pregnancy complications, childbirth medical negligence, congenital illnesses, hospitalisation (up to 30 days), and major hospitalisation for mum. A Baby Protect Plus (III) prenatal rider can be transferred to the child within 100 days from birth with no medical questions asked, aiming at guaranteed coverage for the child up to age 100. Coverage amount options are S$5,000, S$10,000 or S$25,000, which drive the stated benefit payouts.

coverage_scope: Hospitalisation benefits (mum and baby, up to 30 days)

policies.eligibility_notes: Prenatal rider/base can be transferred to the child within 100 days from birth with no medical questions asked; early coverage described as starting at the 13th week of pregnancy. Coverage under the prenatal rider ends after the 3rd policy year, for both mum and baby.
policies.coverage_term_description: Guaranteed lifelong protection for the child stated up to age 100; prenatal rider coverage ends for both mum and baby in the 3rd policy year, and thereafter (if no claims) no claims reward applies per document. Transfer to the child is permitted within 100 days from birth.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Participating whole life plan (document states participating) with stable cash value that accumulates over time; participation/dividend mechanics not specified.

important_caveats: Early Delivery by Caesarean Benefit is stated to be paid only if the procedure is deemed medically necessary by a registered medical practitioner, and it will not apply if the mother is carrying 2 foetuses during pregnancy.

Major Hospitalisation Care Benefit for mum terminates once this benefit is paid or 60 days from birth of the baby, whichever is earlier; upon payout, the Hospital Care Benefit for mum also terminates.

policies.quick_summary: AIA Mum2Baby is the investment-linked bundle under AIA Mum2Baby Choices. It provides prenatal protection for mother and baby beginning as early as the 13th week of pregnancy, with benefits including pregnancy complications, childbirth medical negligence, congenital illnesses, hospitalisation (up to 30 days) for both mum and baby, and a major hospitalisation care benefit for mum. Like the whole life bundle, the base plan and applicable riders can be transferred to the child within 100 days from birth with no medical questions asked, aiming for guaranteed lifelong coverage up to age 100. Coverage amount options are S$5,000, S$10,000 or S$25,000, which drive the stated daily hospitalisation rates and the lump-sum benefits.

Major Hospitalisation Care Benefit for mum terminates once paid or 60 days from the birth of the baby, whichever is earlier; upon payout, the Hospital Care Benefit for mum also terminates.
Hospital Care Benefit for mum automatically terminates once a maximum of 30 days of benefit is paid.
